topic: Benjamin Libet (1983) Readiness Potential vs Conscious Intention ('W-Time' & Veto) & Aaron Schurger (2012) Stochastic Accumulator Resolution (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Aaron Schurger's 2012 computational and empirical breakthrough proving that Libet's -550ms Readiness Potential ramp reflects backward-averaged spontaneous neural noise crests rather than an unconscious deterministic decision.
